Below are three candidate windows that try to maximize overlap across PST / CET / AEST (I put local conversions):

Option A (UTC anchor 14:00):
- PDT: 07:00–08:30
- CET: 16:00–17:30
- AEST: 01:00–02:30 (next day)

Option B (UTC anchor 20:00):
- PDT: 13:00–14:30
- CET: 22:00–23:30
- AEST: 07:00–08:30 (next day)

Option C (early overlap):
- PDT: 22:00–23:30
- CET: 07:00–08:30
- AEST: 16:00–17:30

Notes:
- Option A favors EU attendance but is rough for Sydney.
- Option B is daytime for SF and Sydney but late for CET.
- Option C is the most even split but requires SF to go late.

Vivek and Monica — can you confirm which option you can staff with 2 SEs and whether you prefer bringing a dedicated host VM for the hands-on or to run in Acme's env? Also copying Marissa to flag any DST/holiday constraints from our side.

I'll attach a short outline and a calendar .ics for all three options.
